assumptions: Capability declarations are conservative self-declarations and may establish routing presence only; a declaration is not an independently proven skill benchmark or cross-vendor evidence.

acceptance_results.criterion: Every non-null Ready-or-later manifest role run, including security and product reviewers, has a machine-readable capability declaration.
acceptance_results.result: pass: validator rejects synthetic Ready manifests whose primary or conditional reviewer runs lack declarations; current in-review manifest passes

acceptance_results.criterion: No capability declaration may permit external-secret access.
acceptance_results.result: pass: validator rejects a synthetic declaration with can_access_external_secrets=true

tests.command: Pinned Node v24.20.0/npm 11.19.0: npm run check
tests.result: 18 tests passed; includes four capability-profile tests

security_privacy_cost_impact: Local deterministic validation only. It strengthens the default denial of external-secret access in capability declarations and introduces no credential, provider, customer data, production configuration, or network call.
compatibility_impact: Existing Ready-or-later manifests must now have matching capability declaration files. This is an intentional protocol guard; it does not validate or select a provider/model/domain implementation.
known_limitations: The validator establishes only that a conservative declaration exists. It does not prove the declared skill profile, Product Owner approval, external capability, cross-vendor diversity, or G0 passage.
open_risks_or_blockers: The Product Owner, genuine cross-vendor dry run, skill-benchmark evidence, protected-CI resolution, and all other G0 tracker items remain open.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert this bootstrap-only validator commit if it blocks an unintended manifest, or add an accurate capability declaration after independent review. Do not weaken the external-secret denial or bypass validation.
recommended_next_work_packages: Record independently verifiable skill-benchmark references and genuine second-vendor dry-run evidence before relying on capability declarations for G0.
Do not advance domain packages to ready without their declared dependencies and external approvals.
reviewer_instructions: Exercise valid, external-secret-enabled, duplicate-run, and missing primary/conditional reviewer declaration cases.
Confirm the tracker keeps capability benchmarking and cross-vendor evidence marked partial/open, not complete.
